snippet.title: Handwalk - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Handwalk is a difficult physics-based rage game where you control each hand separately to climb a mountain on your hands.

Play the demo and wishlist Handwalk on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4700550/Handwalk/

#Handwalk #RageGame #IndieGame
